messages:
alex: Hey infra team — opened PR to rewire GPU subnet affinity and update route propagation. can someone take a quick look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4287

maria: looping in @cheng and @dana, will try to review today :+1:

cheng: I'll take a pass in the morning. quick Q: does this change touch the kube ENI attachment order? worried about rolling nodes.

alex: good call. it's a small tf change to subnet tags + a new module for 'gpu-affinity' that adds a route to the gpu subnet route table. nothing that should force node replacement, but it does update tags used by the attach script.

maria: can you paste the `terraform plan` snippet for the route/table and tag changes? want to confirm no resource recreation.

alex: here's the plan excerpt:
```
Terraform will perform the following actions:
  # module.gpu_affinity.aws_route.gpu_route will be created
+ resource "aws_route" "gpu_route" {
    + destination_cidr_block = "10.32.0.0/16"
    + route_table_id         = "rtb-0abcd1234"
    + nat_gateway_id         = (known after apply)
  }
  # aws_subnet.gpu_subnet[0] will be updated in-place
  ~ tags = {
      - "old-tag" = "xyz" -> "new-tag" = "gpu-affinity"
    }

Plan: 1 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
```

cheng: looks fine from my side. creation of the route is ok. just flagging that if `nat_gateway_id` is null during a rollout it could break egress for short period. recommend canary deploy to one AZ first.

dana: Security: tagging change ok, but need KMS approval if we start rotating keys or touching encrypted route table state. are you touching any KMS resources?

alex: not in this PR. KMS rotation work is in a follow-up. This just tags + a route.

infra-bot: CI: terraform plan and validate passed on branch gpu-affinity-2026. 3 checks OK :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. @cheng can you approve once you confirm canary approach? we'll hold merge to the 23:00 UTC maintenance window to reduce risk.

cheng: will approve after I run a quick smoke on the canary stack. ping me once the canary plan is applied.

alex: will do. I'll add a canary flag and update PR with apply instructions. thx everyone :pray:

maria: leaving a gentle reminder — add a short rollback playbook in the PR description if things go sideways.

alex: added rollback steps in PR description and a link to runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/gpu-subnet-reorg

dana: noted. no blockers from security.

alex: marking this as 'awaiting canary verification' and will ping again when applied.
